crossRefs.note: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said…
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
crossRefs.keyword: deny me them not. Heb. withhold them not from me

translations.web: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
translations.bsb: Two things I ask of You— do not refuse me before I die:
translations.kjv: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
translations.asv: Two things have I asked of thee; Deny me them not before I die:
